From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@northbridge.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: SDLC artifact request: keystore rotation, merge approvals, CI logs

Hi Evelyn,

Northbridge is starting our evidence collection for the SOC 2 scoping exercise for Redwood. Can you provide the following artifacts for the Secure SDLC scope (code review, CI/CD controls, secrets/keystore rotation, and change approvals) covering the last 12 months? Specifically: 

- Branch protection and merge-gate policy (any artifacts showing enforced rules)
- A sample of merge approval audit (csv or export) for Q4 2027 (we'll spot-check MRs)
- CI run logs for 2027-12-31 that exercised release gates (build/test/sign steps)
- Keystore/secret rotation log (entries showing rotation events, operator, and change ticket)

Deadline: can we get a first tranche by EOD 2028-01-13? If any of this is sensitive, a secure link or an encrypted bundle is fine.

Thanks — appreciate a point person to coordinate.

Alex
Alex Reed
Senior Assessor, Northbridge Security
alex.reed@northbridge.com

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear list. I'm the engagement lead for this request. Marcus (Engineering) and Monica (Security) are looped for the artifact pulls and any redaction.

We can provide a first tranche by EOD 2028-01-13. To confirm scope/format quickly: 
- We'll provide CSV export for merge approvals and a short explanatory readme.

- Keystore rotation will be a CSV audit (no secret material), plus the KMS rotation policy reference.

If Northbridge prefers encrypted S3 links, provide a recipient pubkey and we'll package accordingly.

I'll follow up with a consolidated link once Marcus/Monica confirm.

Best,

Subject: Re: SDLC artifact request: keystore rotation, merge approvals, CI logs

Alex / team — quick technical summary and what's attached. I'm the engineering owner for the artifacts below.

Summary of controls (high level):
- Protected branches: main, release/* with required status checks and minimum 2 reviewers. All merges go through our gated pipeline.
- Required code review: PROTECTED_LABEL = "security-review" enforced for changes touching infra or secrets.
- CI gating: release pipeline has sign-off, static analysis, and integration test stages. Failed gates block the merge.
- Keystore management: keys are stored in a KMS (cloud-managed) with rotation policy enforced via scheduled rotation jobs and operator approvals logged in our ticketing system.

Artifacts provided in this tranche (attachments / links):
- branch-protection-policy-v3.pdf (export from policy repo)
- merge-approvals-audit-2027Q4.csv (redacted user IDs)
- ci-run-logs-20271231.tar.gz (contains job-level logs and build metadata)

Notes: merge-approvals csv includes MR id, author, approvers, timestamps, and ticket link (Jira). CI tarball contains the run id 4589 that exercised the release gate on 2027-12-31. We redacted ephemeral runner hostnames.

If you need the raw MR for SEC-7123 (mentioned below) we can provide an encrypted export — let us know.

Subject: Re: SDLC artifact request: keystore rotation, merge approvals, CI logs

Alex/Marcus/Evelyn — attaching the keystore rotation export and KMS policy pointers. A few implementation notes below.

What I'm attaching:
- keystore-rotation-log-2027.csv (columns: timestamp, key_id, rotated_by, ticket_id, rotation_method, comments)
- keystore-rotation-policy.md (short summary)

Rotation process notes: 
- Keys are rotated on a 90-day rolling schedule via our KMS. Rotation jobs are triggered by a scheduler service and require operator confirmation when they touch production KEs.
- All rotation events create a ticket in our tracking system; ticket ids are included in the CSV.
- No secrets or key material is included in the CSV — only metadata.

I've also added the KMS audit link under a secure bucket (see Drive link below). If Northbridge needs signed attestations for any particular rotation event, we can produce a signed envelope for that event.
